europe_now.title: French Nationwide Strikes and Protests
europe_now.summary: Protests across France drew hundreds of thousands of participants as unions organized strikes over the high cost of living and public services. Interior ministry estimates placed turnout at six hundred thousand, while union organizers claimed numbers reached close to 1.6 million.
